description: Open US/Canadian government bid solicitations (state, local, federal) listed on BidNet Direct's free public search: title, location, publication and closing dates, notice id and link. Keyword search, newest first, 25 per page. Only the public teaser fields are returned; full bid documents on BidNet Direct need a (free or paid) vendor account and are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: Keyword(s), e.g. road, paving, janitorial. Empty = all open bids.
